desc: Combo Top w/ Plastic Window
model: CAVALIER (ASC) - unfinished front, 4 bow seam on rear
notes: Unfinished front has no binding, but has front weather seal, supplied with rear pad assembly. White vinyl tops made with black binding along sides and front, rear window binding matches top material. *CAUTION* There is some confusion on the 1995 1/2 - 1996 Cavaliers. From the information received from the field, there are early 1996 Cavaliers being sold as late 1995’s. To determine which year car you have, measure the raw glass size of the rear window. Make sure when you take your measurements, that you measure under the fabric to the edge of the raw glass. Finished front cars should measure 15 1/2” x 32”. If this is the case then use our #144. Unfinished front cars should measure 15 3/4” x 34 1/2”. If this is the case, then use our #157. It is important to verify which one you have before ordering a replacement top.

desc: Combo Top w/ Plastic Window
model: SUNFIRE(ASC) - unfinished front, 4 bow seam on rear
notes: Unfinished front has no binding, but has front weather seal, supplied with rear pad assembly. White vinyl tops made with black binding along sides and front, rear window binding matches top material. *CAUTION* There is some confusion on the 1995 1/2 - 1996 Cavaliers. From the information received from the field, there are early 1996 Cavaliers being sold as late 1995’s. To determine which year car you have, measure the raw glass size of the rear window. Make sure when you take your measurements, that you measure under the fabric to the edge of the raw glass. Finished front cars should measure 15 1/2” x 32”. If this is the case then use our #144. Unfinished front cars should measure 15 3/4” x 34 1/2”. If this is the case, then use our #157. It is important to verify which one you have before ordering a replacement top.
